decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up approach: left to the left bunny, right toward the right-hand car. Assign white to bunnies, blue to cars, red to pens; grasp alignment remains to be checked.
Tilt both grippers toward top-down while approaching above the bunny torso and right car, keeping clearance before final visual alignment.
Refine overhead alignment from wrist views. Center the left bunny torso and rotate the right jaws across the car's width while advancing above it.
Lower a small amount to engage the bunny torso and car sides, close both grippers, then begin a short retention-check lift.
Lift both objects clear while keeping the grippers closed, then start toward the white and blue baskets. Retention will be judged from the next images.
Both objects remain visible between the fingers. Carry the bunny over white and the car over blue, maintaining closed grippers and overhead clearance.
Replan after the right-arm continuity rejection: use smaller motions, lower the wrists, and tilt forward to place over baskets without extending the wrists as far.
Center each retained object within its assigned basket, lower slightly, and open both grippers for release. Check settling and clearance next.
Withdraw open grippers from the released bunny and car, then approach the remaining bunny and central car with overhead clearance. Reorient the right jaws across the second car.
Align left fingers around the remaining bunny's torso and right fingers across the central car; descend gradually with both grippers open.
Use wrist views for a final small alignment, especially the car's offset from the jaws. Close around both objects and lift a short distance to test retention.
Lift the second bunny and car clear, then carry toward their matching baskets with closed grippers. Tilt forward during transport to preserve elbow-up reach margin.
Advance the retained second objects over the interiors of white and blue, lowering toward release height while keeping clear of the first objects.
Open to release the second bunny and car inside their matching baskets, allow a brief settle, then withdraw both arms. The remaining pens will go into red.
The two bunnies and two cars are visibly in their assigned baskets. Retract the left arm toward origin and move the right above the black pen with open fingers.
Finish returning the left arm near origin. Align the right gripper across the black pen's shaft and descend cautiously for a narrow-object grasp.
Correct the black pen's lateral offset using the wrist view, lower to its shaft, and close. Keep the left arm open at origin; retention still needs a lift check.
Lift the black pen clear with the right gripper closed, then start toward red while tilting forward for reach margin. Verify the pen remains between the fingers.
The black pen remains retained. Carry it forward over the red basket and lower toward a controlled release, maintaining the left arm at origin.
Release the black pen into red, briefly allow it to settle, then withdraw the open right gripper toward the remaining white pen and begin aligning across its shaft.
Black pen is visibly in red. Bring the open right fingers down toward the white pen, correcting its lateral offset and making the grasp direction nearly vertical.
Correct the white pen's remaining wrist-view offset, lower to the shaft, close the right gripper, and start a small lift to check retention.
Lift the white pen with the right gripper closed, then move toward red and tilt forward for a compact elbow-up placement approach. Check that the pen stays retained.
Carry the retained white pen fully over red and lower for release. The black pen appears displaced toward the rear rim; inspect its settled position after placing white.
Release the white pen inside red, then retract open fingers upward and back. Inspect both pens after settling, especially the black pen near the rear-left rim.
White is inside red, but black appears supported on the left rim. Approach its shaft with open right fingers to reposition it fully inside before returning home.
Use the wrist view to align across the black shaft near the rim, descend slightly, and close for a corrective grasp. Retention is uncertain until the lift check.
Lift the black pen from the rim and shift it toward the red basket's center with the gripper closed. Check that it follows before lowering for release.
The black pen did not follow the lift. Reopen and reapproach the same shaft at a lower height; use the next wrist view to check depth before closing again.
Make a small lateral correction at the lower grasp height, close around the black shaft, and lift only a short distance to verify whether it leaves the rim.
The black pen still appears rim-supported. Reopen and shift the grasp along its shaft toward the basket interior, away from the rim, before closing again.
Allow the close command to settle without further downward pressure, then make only a short upward retention check. The rim may still obstruct the grasp.

Repeated shaft grasps have not lifted the pen. Withdraw clear of the rim and approach the exposed cap from the basket's left side for a small inward correction rather than continuing the obstructed grasp.
Replan from the continuity interruption without moving farther left. Lower slightly toward the exposed cap and close at this higher contact point, away from the basket floor.
Move the closed fingers slowly inward from the exposed cap, with a slight lift and retreat to preserve reach margin. Check whether the black pen follows or is nudged off the rim.
The pen did not follow. Reapproach the cap with a small forward and downward correction from its wrist-view offset, keeping the fingers open and avoiding farther lateral extension.
Stop lateral motion at the observed pose because the rim may be contacting an open finger. Close in place around the visually centered black shaft before any further lift.
The shaft remains rim-supported. Make a small backward and downward correction with only a partial opening, aiming to get the pads around the exposed cap rather than the rim.
Correct the shaft's leftward wrist-image offset while lowering a little farther, then close in place. Keep the opening narrow to avoid the basket wall.
Keep closed and lift the apparent cap grasp while retreating slightly from the reach limit. Shift toward the basket center; confirm that the black pen follows.
The black pen now follows the fingers. Move it inward and lower over the red basket while keeping closed, leaving its full length clear of the rim.
Release black well inside red and lift the open right fingers vertically clear before retracting, to avoid dragging either pen onto a rim. Correct the left arm's small home drift.
Both pens now appear flat inside red, with two bunnies in white and two cars in blue. Retract the open right arm and unwind its orientation toward home while preserving elbow-up continuity.
All three categories remain visibly separated. Continue the right arm's open-gripper return toward origin, lowering gradually while unwinding the remaining rotation.
Complete the right arm's gradual return to its initial pose with both grippers open. The objects remain settled in their category baskets.
